content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows that sets taken close to failure build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as the effort is high and the volume is adequate.

Your goal is a 100 kg bench in three months, though. That's a strength goal, so you do need to train heavy, in the 1 to 6 rep range, to practice the skill with maximal loads. A mix works best: heavy sets on the main lifts, then moderate-rep work (8 to 15) for size. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
